# Solana Icons

> Open-source icon library for the Solana ecosystem. Free SVG and PNG downloads.

- Site: https://icons.sol.new
- npm: `npm i solana-icons`
- License: MIT
- Icons: 567+ (wallets, DEXes, platforms, protocols, brand)
- Includes: Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, Jupiter (jup.ag), BONK, pump.fun, FOMO, Raydium, Orca, Kamino, QuickNode, Alchemy
- GitHub: https://github.com/metasal1/solana-icons
- Source extras: Solana Foundation ecosystem-data company assets

## Use

- Browse and **download as PNG image** (128/256/512)
- Copy SVG or download SVG code
- Install package for app usage
